name: Guarding
desc: You are braced behind your shield.  Block attempts are more reliable and absorb more physical damage.

name: Evading
desc: You are concentrating on evading attacks.  Your dodge improves, subject to normal limb and stamina limits.

name: Recovering
desc: You are catching your breath.  Dodging is weakened and you cannot block.

name: Winding up
desc: A heavy strike is being prepared.  Guard, evade, interrupt, or move out of the threatened tile.

name: Heavy strike recovery
desc: This creature cannot prepare another heavy strike yet.
